The effective rate is federal income tax divided by gross income. Rates cover ordinary income only, before credits, and leave out Social Security, Medicare and state taxes. Qualified dividends and long-term capital gains have their own lower rates.

How your taxable income fills the brackets

Each rate applies only to the slice of income inside its bracket. The bracket holding your last dollar, shown in bold, is your marginal rate.
